# Agents

Build AI-powered agents to perform tasks, persist state, browse the web, and communicate in real-time

> Links below point directly to Markdown versions of each page. Any page can also be retrieved as Markdown by sending an `Accept: text/markdown` header to the page's URL without the `index.md` suffix (for example, `curl -H "Accept: text/markdown" https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/`).
>
> For other Cloudflare products, see the [Cloudflare documentation directory](https://developers.cloudflare.com/llms.txt).

## Overview

- [Build Agents on Cloudflare](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/index.md): Build and host AI agents on Cloudflare. Run an agent harness in a Durable Object, add capabilities such as state, WebSockets, and scheduling with the Agents SDK Lifecycle, and give the agent tools.

## Getting started

- [Getting started](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/getting-started/index.md): Start building Agents on Cloudflare. Run the Pi harness in a Durable Object, learn the Agents SDK Lifecycle, or add an agent to a project you already have.
- [Add to an existing project](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/getting-started/add-to-existing-project/index.md): Add the Agents SDK Lifecycle to a Durable Object in an existing Cloudflare Workers project, then add capabilities such as state, WebSockets, and scheduling.
- [Learn the runtime](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/getting-started/learn-the-runtime/index.md): Learn the runtime under every agent. Build a counter on a Durable Object with the Agents SDK Lifecycle, add durable state and WebSockets, then connect a client that stays in sync.
- [Build your first Durable Agent](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/getting-started/quick-start/index.md): Build your first agent on Cloudflare. Run the Pi harness in a Durable Object with the Lifecycle, give it a Cloudflare Computer workspace, connect to it over WebSockets, and deploy it.
- [Testing your Agents](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/getting-started/testing-your-agent/index.md): Write and run tests for Cloudflare Agents using Vitest and the Workers test pool.

## Concepts

- [Agent Skills](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/concepts/agent-skills/index.md): What Agent Skills are, how agents load them through progressive disclosure, what the open SKILL.md format specifies, and what you can build with them.
- [Agentic patterns](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/concepts/agentic-patterns/index.md): Implement common AI agent patterns like prompt chaining, routing, parallelization, and orchestrator-workers on Cloudflare.
- [Human-in-the-loop patterns](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/concepts/agentic-patterns/human-in-the-loop/index.md): Implement human-in-the-loop functionality using Workflow approvals, durable Code Mode approvals, and MCP elicitation.
- [Long-running agents](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/concepts/agentic-patterns/long-running-agents/index.md): Build agents that persist for days, weeks, or months — surviving restarts, waking on demand, and managing work that spans far longer than any single request.
- [Calling LLMs](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/concepts/calling-llms/index.md): Call large language models from within a stateful Cloudflare Agent with persistent context and autonomous scheduling.
- [Conversation state and memory](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/concepts/conversation-state-and-memory/index.md): How agents store and recall information, including read-only context, writable short-form memory, searchable knowledge, and on-demand skills.
- [Harness](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/concepts/harness/index.md): A harness is the agent loop around a model. Learn what a harness does, how its brain and hands split across Cloudflare, and which harness to start with.
- [Tools](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/concepts/tools/index.md): Understand how tools are exposed to models, where tools execute, and how MCP connects external tools to Cloudflare Agents.
- [What are agents?](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/concepts/what-are-agents/index.md): Understand what Agents are, how they differ from workflows and co-pilots, and when to use them.
- [Using Agents with Workflows](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/concepts/workflows/index.md): Integrate Cloudflare Workflows with Agents for durable, multi-step background processing with automatic retries.

## Runtime

- [Runtime](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/runtime/index.md): The Agents SDK runtime is a Durable Object with the Lifecycle installed, a Worker that routes requests to it, and the capabilities you attach to it.
- [Capabilities](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/runtime/capabilities/index.md): Add features to a Durable Object one capability at a time with lifecycle.use(). Capabilities accept WebSocket clients, sync state, schedule work, connect to MCP servers, and store streams and conversations.
- [Build a capability](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/runtime/capabilities/build-a-capability/index.md): Write your own reusable Lifecycle capability with LifecycleCapability, including storage, durable jobs, request handling, events, and user callbacks.
- [MCPClientManager](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/runtime/capabilities/mcp-client-manager/index.md): Connect a Durable Object to MCP servers with the MCPClientManager capability, including OAuth, elicitation, reconnection after restarts, and AI SDK tools.
- [Scheduler](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/runtime/capabilities/scheduler/index.md): Run callbacks on a Durable Object after a delay, at a date, from a cron expression, or on an interval with the Scheduler capability.
- [Sessions](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/runtime/capabilities/sessions/index.md): Store durable conversation history in a Durable Object with the Sessions capability. Messages form a tree with branches, compaction, full-text search, streamed reads, and a change feed.
- [State](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/runtime/capabilities/state/index.md): Store one validated value in a Durable Object with the State capability, and sync it to useAgent clients in real time with WebSockets.
- [Streams](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/runtime/capabilities/streams/index.md): Store incremental output, such as model tokens, in a durable chunk log with the Streams capability. Readers replay from a cursor, then follow live appends, and SSE resume works without client code.
- [WebSockets](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/runtime/capabilities/websockets/index.md): Accept hibernating WebSocket connections on a Durable Object, serve methods to useAgent clients, and tag, broadcast to, and restrict connections with the WebSockets capability.
- [Lifecycle](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/runtime/lifecycle/index.md): Install the Lifecycle from agents/lifecycle on a Durable Object to get startup, request dispatch, a durable job queue that owns the alarm, object names, and teardown.
- [Lifecycle API](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/runtime/lifecycle/api-reference/index.md): Reference for every export of agents/lifecycle, including the Lifecycle class, host hooks, capability hooks, Lifecycle services, job types, and context types.
- [getCurrentAgent()](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/runtime/lifecycle/get-current-agent/index.md): Read the current Durable Object, request, and WebSocket connection from shared code with getCurrentAgent() from agents/lifecycle.
- [Jobs and alarms](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/runtime/lifecycle/job-queue/index.md): Push durable jobs onto the Lifecycle job queue, handle them with onJob(), and control retries, rescheduling, long-running work, and memory-limit protection.
- [Diagnostics channels](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/runtime/observability/diagnostics-channels/index.md): Subscribe to structured events from the Lifecycle, its capabilities, and the Agent class, including RPC calls, schedules, jobs, and MCP connections.
- [Tracing](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/runtime/observability/tracing/index.md): Trace model calls, tool runs, and approvals with Workers traces.
- [Routing](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/runtime/routing/index.md): Route HTTP requests and WebSocket upgrades from your Worker to a named Durable Object with routeAgentRequest(), and choose how to name your agents.
- [Authentication](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/runtime/routing/authentication/index.md): Check who is calling in your Worker before routeAgentRequest() forwards an HTTP request or WebSocket upgrade to an agent, and limit each user to their own agents.
- [Custom routing](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/runtime/routing/custom-routing/index.md): Reach a Lifecycle Durable Object without the default /agents/:binding/:name URL. Pick the object on the server, forward requests with getByName(), and call it over RPC.
- [HTTP and Server-Sent Events](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/runtime/routing/http-sse/index.md): Handle HTTP requests in onRequest() and stream responses with Server-Sent Events from a Durable Object with the Lifecycle.
- [Routing options](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/runtime/routing/options/index.md): Configure routeAgentRequest() with a URL prefix, CORS headers, jurisdiction and location hints, startup props, and retries for transient Durable Object errors.

## Tools

- [Tools](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/tools/index.md)
- [AI Search](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/tools/ai-search/index.md): Give agents retrieval capabilities with Cloudflare AI Search.
- [Browser](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/tools/browser/index.md): Give your agent a browser that remembers tabs, cookies, and logins between turns, and can open sites your agent serves itself. Use it with Pi Durable, the AI SDK, or another harness.
- [Code Mode](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/tools/codemode/index.md): Use Code Mode to let models discover and compose tools by writing code as a compact, executable plan.
- [AI SDK integration](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/tools/codemode/ai-sdk/index.md): Use AI SDK tools with Code Mode through createCodeTool(), namespaced providers, or ToolSetConnector for durable execution.
- [Code Mode API reference](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/tools/codemode/api-reference/index.md): Reference the public classes, functions, options, runtime methods, connector hooks, and result types exported by Code Mode.
- [Browser integration](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/tools/codemode/browser/index.md): Run model-generated code against browser-owned tools with the Code Mode iframe executor and an Agent chat UI.
- [Create a durable Code Mode runtime](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/tools/codemode/durable-runtime/index.md): Create a Code Mode runtime with connectors, direct host APIs, durable approvals, rollback, execution history, and reusable snippets.
- [How Code Mode works](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/tools/codemode/how-it-works/index.md): Learn how Code Mode isolates generated code and makes approvals, replay, rollback, and reuse durable.
- [Use MCP tools with Code Mode](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/tools/codemode/mcp/index.md): Expose tools from an existing MCP connection to models through a durable Code Mode runtime.
- [Use an OpenAPI service with Code Mode](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/tools/codemode/openapi/index.md): Turn OpenAPI operations into typed Code Mode connector methods while keeping authentication in the host Worker.
- [Use Code Mode with TanStack AI](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/tools/codemode/tanstack-ai/index.md): Use @cloudflare/codemode/tanstack-ai to expose namespaced TanStack AI server tools through chat().
- [File system](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/tools/filesystem/index.md): Give an agent a virtual file system stored in its Durable Object, with file tools for the model and an optional JavaScript runtime.
- [MCP](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/tools/mcp/index.md): Connect agents to external Model Context Protocol servers and use their tools in model calls.
- [Agentic Payments](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/tools/payments/index.md): Let AI agents pay for services with x402 or Machine Payments Protocol (MPP) through Cloudflare's Agents SDK.
- [MPP (Machine Payments Protocol)](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/tools/payments/mpp/index.md): Accept and make payments using Machine Payments Protocol (MPP) with Cloudflare Workers and the Agents SDK.
- [Charge for HTTP content](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/tools/payments/mpp-charge-for-http-content/index.md): Gate HTTP endpoints with MPP payments using the mpp-proxy template on Cloudflare Workers.
- [Accept payments with MPP](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/tools/payments/mpp/accept-payments/index.md): Accept Machine Payments Protocol (MPP) payments from an origin, Cloudflare Worker route, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool.
- [Pay from the Agents SDK](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/tools/payments/mpp/pay-from-agents-sdk/index.md): Configure a Cloudflare Agent to pay HTTP services and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools with Machine Payments Protocol (MPP).
- [x402](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/tools/payments/x402/index.md): Accept and make machine-to-machine payments using the x402 HTTP payment protocol on Cloudflare Workers and the Agents SDK.
- [Charge for HTTP content](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/tools/payments/x402/charge-for-http-content/index.md): Gate HTTP endpoints with x402 payments using a Cloudflare Worker proxy.
- [Charge for MCP tools](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/tools/payments/x402/charge-for-mcp-tools/index.md): Charge per tool call in an MCP server using paidTool.
- [Pay from Agents SDK](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/tools/payments/x402/pay-from-agents-sdk/index.md): Use withX402Client to pay for resources from a Cloudflare Agent.
- [Pay from coding tools](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/tools/payments/x402/pay-with-tool-plugins/index.md): Add x402 payment handling to OpenCode and Claude Code.
- [Sandbox](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/tools/sandbox/index.md): Give an agent a Linux sandbox to run shell commands, scripts, and tests.
- [Skills](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/tools/skills/index.md): Give your agent Agent Skills tools to discover, load, and read skills on demand. Use Think, Pi Durable, AI SDK, or your own harness.
- [Web fetch](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/tools/web-fetch/index.md): Give your agent a web fetch tool with document conversion, pagination, and request controls. Use Pi Durable, AI SDK, TanStack AI, or your own harness.
- [Web search](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/tools/web-search/index.md): Give your agent a web search tool backed by the Cloudflare Web Search API. Use Pi Durable, AI SDK, TanStack AI, or your own harness.

## Models

- [Models](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/models/index.md): Call Workers AI, AI Gateway catalog models, dynamic routes, and vendor models from the AI SDK or Pi AI with one createAI provider over the AI binding or an account id and API token.
- [AI SDK](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/models/ai-sdk/index.md): Use createAI from agents/models/ai-sdk to call Workers AI models, AI Gateway catalog models, dynamic routes, and vendor AI SDK models through the AI binding or an account id and API token.
- [Pi AI](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/models/pi-ai/index.md): Use createAI from agents/models/pi-ai to run Workers AI models, AI Gateway catalog models, dynamic routes, and Pi AI model objects through the AI binding or an account id and API token with Pi AI, Pi Durable, and the Pi harness.

## Agent Skills

- [Agent Skills](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/skills/index.md): Give an agent on-demand instructions, references, and scripts as Agent Skills, loaded from a Computer Workspace, R2, or code.
- [Execution](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/skills/execution/index.md): Run Agent Skills scripts with a Computer Workspace backend, or with the experimental skill script runner.
- [Code](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/skills/sources/code/index.md): Define Agent Skills in code with skills.manifest(), for tests and small fixed sets of skills.
- [Computer](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/skills/sources/computer/index.md): Store Agent Skills as files in a Computer Workspace, so skills the agent or a user writes are available on the next turn.
- [R2](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/skills/sources/r2/index.md): Load Agent Skills from an R2 bucket that uses the Agent Skills directory layout.

## Harnesses

- [Harnesses](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/harnesses/index.md): Compare agent harnesses on Cloudflare by execution environment, recovery behavior, and persistent workspace integration.
- [Build your own harness](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/harnesses/build-your-own/index.md): Write your own agent loop as a Lifecycle capability, using the experimental Sessions, Streams, and Tasks capabilities or HarnessStore.
- [Claude Code](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/harnesses/claude-code/index.md): Run Claude Code on Cloudflare. The CLI runs in a Container, with its own plugins, mods, and settings, and a Durable Object keeps its sessions and credentials.
- [Codex](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/harnesses/codex/index.md): Run OpenAI Codex on Cloudflare. The CLI runs in a Container, with its own tools and configuration, and a Durable Object keeps its sessions and credentials.
- [Exo](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/harnesses/exo/index.md): Explore Exo's Cloudflare adapter, with Rust and WebAssembly orchestration, per-thread Durable Objects, and Linux sandboxes.
- [Nanocode](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/harnesses/nanocode/index.md): Run Nanocode on Cloudflare Workers with its own Durable Object host, and connect optional Agents SDK capabilities.
- [OpenCode](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/harnesses/opencode/index.md): Run OpenCode 2.0 in a plain Durable Object with the Agents SDK, Workers AI and AI Gateway models, bundled plugins, and durable sessions.
- [Pi](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/harnesses/pi/index.md): Run the Pi Durable harness on Cloudflare with the Agents SDK. PiHarness keeps your agent's work durable inside a Durable Object, even if it is interrupted mid-turn.
- [Extensions](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/harnesses/pi/extensions/index.md): Add tools, system prompt sections, and skills to a PiHarness with Pi Durable extensions.
- [Self-modifying](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/harnesses/self-modifying/index.md): Explore an experimental harness that edits TypeScript in a durable Workspace and runs activated revisions in Dynamic Workers.
- [Think](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/harnesses/think/index.md): Opinionated chat agent framework with built-in tools, persistent memory, lifecycle hooks, streaming, messengers, scheduled tasks, Workflows, and sub-agent RPC.
- [Actions](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/harnesses/think/actions/index.md): Server-side Think tools with idempotency, human approvals, authorization, and reply attachments.
- [Channels](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/harnesses/think/channels/index.md): Apply per-channel policy, select a channel on a turn, and deliver out-of-band notices across web, messenger, voice, and custom surfaces.
- [Client tools](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/harnesses/think/client-tools/index.md): Browser-side tools, approval flows, auto-continuation, message concurrency, and multi-tab broadcast for Think agents.
- [Configuration](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/harnesses/think/configuration/index.md): Configuration overrides, dynamic runtime configuration, Session integration, and package exports for the Think chat agent framework.
- [Getting started](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/harnesses/think/getting-started/index.md): Build a Think chat agent with persistent memory, built-in file tools, custom tools, and streaming, step by step.
- [Lifecycle hooks](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/harnesses/think/lifecycle-hooks/index.md): Hooks at each stage of a Think chat turn — beforeTurn, beforeStep, beforeToolCall, afterToolCall, onStepFinish, onChunk, onChatResponse, and onChatError.
- [Messengers](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/harnesses/think/messengers/index.md): Receive and reply to Chat SDK messenger webhooks directly from a Think agent, including Telegram setup, routing, conversation targets, and recovery.
- [Programmatic submissions](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/harnesses/think/programmatic-submissions/index.md): Durably accept a Think turn with submitMessages() for webhooks and RPC callers, with idempotent retry, status inspection, and cancellation.
- [Durable recovery](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/harnesses/think/recovery/index.md): Bounded chat recovery, the stream-stall watchdog, repairing interrupted tool calls, and stability detection for Think agents.
- [Scheduled tasks](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/harnesses/think/scheduled-tasks/index.md): Declare recurring, timezone-aware Think turns and deterministic handlers with getScheduledTasks() and a typed scheduling DSL.
- [Sub-agent RPC and programmatic turns](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/harnesses/think/sub-agents/index.md): Stream Think turns through a child agent with chat(), and trigger turns programmatically with saveMessages(), continueLastTurn(), and abort.
- [Tools](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/harnesses/think/tools/index.md): Built-in workspace tools, custom tools, approvals, MCP tools, code execution, browser tools, and extensions for Think agents.
- [Workflows](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/harnesses/think/workflows/index.md): Run a durable model-driven reasoning step inside a Cloudflare Workflow with ThinkWorkflow and step.prompt(), including structured output and timeouts.

## Examples

- [Browser agent](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/examples/browser-agent/index.md): Build an agent that uses Browser Run tools to inspect pages, capture screenshots, scrape rendered content, and debug frontend issues.
- [Chat agent](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/examples/chat-agent/index.md): Build a streaming AI chat agent with tools using Workers AI — no API keys required.
- [Email agent](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/examples/email-agent/index.md): Build an agent that sends, receives, routes, and replies to email using Cloudflare Email Service and the Agents SDK.
- [Slack agent](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/examples/slack-agent/index.md): Build and deploy an AI-powered Slack bot on Cloudflare Workers using the Agents SDK.
- [Voice agent](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/examples/voice-agent/index.md): Build a real-time voice agent with speech-to-text, LLM processing, and text-to-speech on Cloudflare Workers.

## Agent class

- [Agent class](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/agent-class/index.md): Reference for the Agent base class, its hooks, SQL storage, and error handling in the Agents SDK.
- [Agents as tools](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/agent-class/agent-tools/index.md): Run Think and AIChatAgent sub-agents as retained, streaming tools from a parent agent.
- [Callable methods](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/agent-class/callable-methods/index.md): Expose Agent methods to browsers and other clients with the @callable() decorator, including typed stubs and streaming responses.
- [Chat SDK](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/agent-class/communication-channels/chat-sdk/index.md): Integrate Chat SDK with Agents, including durable state for subscriptions, locks, queues, and message history.
- [Autonomous responses](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/agent-class/communication-channels/chat/autonomous-responses/index.md): Send server-initiated messages and trigger LLM responses from Cloudflare Agents without user action.
- [Chat agents](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/agent-class/communication-channels/chat/chat-agents/index.md): Build AI chat interfaces with AIChatAgent and useAgentChat, including message persistence, streaming, and tool support.
- [Client SDK](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/agent-class/communication-channels/chat/client-sdk/index.md): Connect to Cloudflare Agents from browsers or server runtimes using useAgent, AgentClient, and agentFetch.
- [Email](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/agent-class/communication-channels/email/index.md): Connect agents to email so they can send outbound messages, process inbound mail, and handle follow-up replies.
- [Slack](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/agent-class/communication-channels/slack/index.md): Connect agents to Slack workspaces so they can respond to direct messages, mentions, and threaded conversations.
- [Voice](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/agent-class/communication-channels/voice/index.md): Build real-time voice agents with speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and conversation persistence over WebSocket.
- [Webhooks](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/agent-class/communication-channels/webhooks/index.md): Receive and route webhook events from external services to dedicated Cloudflare Agent instances.
- [Push notifications](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/agent-class/communication-channels/webhooks/push-notifications/index.md): Send browser push notifications from a Cloudflare Agent, even when the user has closed the tab.
- [Durable execution with fibers](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/agent-class/durable-execution/index.md): Run work that survives Durable Object eviction with runFiber(), startFiber(), keepAlive(), and crash recovery.
- [Agent class internals](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/agent-class/internals/index.md): Explore how the Agent class extends Durable Objects to provide state, WebSockets, scheduling, and RPC.
- [Protocol messages](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/agent-class/protocol-messages/index.md): Turn off the identity, state, and MCP protocol frames an Agent sends to WebSocket clients, for binary or minimal clients.
- [Queue tasks](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/agent-class/queue-tasks/index.md): Add background tasks to a built-in FIFO queue for asynchronous processing within Cloudflare Agents.
- [Readonly connections](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/agent-class/readonly-connections/index.md): Restrict WebSocket clients to view-only access so they receive Agent state without changing it.
- [Retries](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/agent-class/retries/index.md): Retry failed operations with exponential backoff and jitter using the built-in retry system in the Agents SDK.
- [Routing](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/agent-class/routing/index.md): Route requests to an Agent with routeAgentRequest(), call it from a Worker with getAgentByName(), and pass props to onStart().
- [Run Workflows](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/agent-class/run-workflows/index.md): Integrate Cloudflare Workflows with Agents for durable, multi-step background processing and failure recovery.
- [Schedule tasks](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/agent-class/schedule-tasks/index.md): Schedule delayed, dated, cron, and interval callbacks on an Agent with this.schedule(), and keep an Agent alive during long work.
- [Store and sync state](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/agent-class/state/index.md): Persist Agent state with initialState and setState(), validate client changes, react to updates, and sync state to useAgent clients.
- [Sub-agents](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/agent-class/sub-agents/index.md): Spawn child agents with isolated storage and typed RPC using subAgent(), abortSubAgent(), and deleteSubAgent().
- [WebSockets](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/agent-class/websockets/index.md): Accept WebSocket connections on an Agent with onConnect() and onMessage(), broadcast to clients, tag connections, and control hibernation.

## Model Context Protocol (MCP)

- [Model Context Protocol (MCP)](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/model-context-protocol/index.md): Build and deploy remote MCP servers on Cloudflare to connect AI agents with external tools and services.
- [McpAgent (deprecated)](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/model-context-protocol/apis/agent-api/index.md): Reference the deprecated, feature-frozen McpAgent class while migrating existing stateful MCP servers to stateless handlers.
- [MCP Client](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/model-context-protocol/apis/client-api/index.md): Connect Agents to external MCP servers to use their tools, resources, and prompts over the Model Context Protocol.
- [MCP Server](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/model-context-protocol/apis/handler-api/index.md): Create stateless MCP servers on Cloudflare Workers with createMcpHandler from the Agents SDK.
- [MCP server portals](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/access-controls/ai-controls/mcp-portals/index.md): Centralize multiple MCP servers onto a single endpoint and customize the tools, prompts, and resources available to users.
- [Cloudflare's own MCP servers](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/model-context-protocol/cloudflare/servers-for-cloudflare/index.md): Connect to Cloudflare's managed remote MCP servers to read configurations, manage services, and automate actions across your account.
- [Cloudflare Community MCP Server](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/model-context-protocol/cloudflare/servers-for-cloudflare/community-mcp-server/index.md): Learn how to use the Cloudflare Community MCP server to search topics, read posts, and filter content.
- [Build a Code Mode MCP server](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/model-context-protocol/guides/build-codemode-mcp-server/index.md): Expose an MCP server or a large OpenAPI service to any MCP client through sandboxed, model-written code.
- [Connect to an MCP server](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/model-context-protocol/guides/connect-mcp-client/index.md): Create a Cloudflare Agent that connects to an external MCP server and uses its tools.
- [Migrate to MCP SDK v2](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/model-context-protocol/guides/migrate-to-mcp-sdk-v2/index.md): Migrate Agents SDK MCP servers and clients to the split MCP TypeScript SDK v2 packages while retaining legacy compatibility.
- [Handle OAuth with MCP servers](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/model-context-protocol/guides/oauth-mcp-client/index.md): Implement OAuth authentication flows in Cloudflare Agents to connect to protected MCP servers.
- [Build a Remote MCP server](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/model-context-protocol/guides/remote-mcp-server/index.md): Deploy a remote MCP server on Cloudflare with optional authentication using Streamable HTTP transport.
- [Securing MCP servers](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/model-context-protocol/guides/securing-mcp-server/index.md): Secure your MCP servers with OAuth 2.1, token validation, and scope-based access control on Cloudflare.
- [Test a Remote MCP Server](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/model-context-protocol/guides/test-remote-mcp-server/index.md): Test your remote MCP server using the MCP Inspector and compatible MCP clients.
- [Authorization](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/model-context-protocol/protocol/authorization/index.md): Protect an MCP server with OAuth 2.1 using an authorization server and a resource server built with Workers OAuth Provider.
- [MCP governance](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/model-context-protocol/protocol/governance/index.md): Control which MCP servers your organization uses and enforce access policies with Cloudflare Access.
- [Tools](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/model-context-protocol/protocol/tools/index.md): Define, register, and manage MCP tools that expose server-side functions for AI agents to call.
- [Transport](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/model-context-protocol/protocol/transport/index.md): Configure Streamable HTTP transport for remote MCP servers built with the Agents SDK.

## Platform

- [Limits](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/platform/limits/index.md): Understand the concurrency, storage, and compute time limits that apply to Cloudflare Agents.
